title: GUI-Enhance FSM
description: Guides generation and provides the basis for validation. Describes WHAT must be true of the environment (which facts are gated behind which interactions), never HOW to implement it. No selectors, no DOM structure, no component choices -- those belong entirely to the coding agent.

domain.description: e.g. Developer Tools, Financial ERP, Observability

app_concept.description: One line: what the app pretends to be.

signature_vars.description: Page signature sigma: the controllable configuration carried across states.

visible_data.description: Prose: what data is legible to a user standing in this state. The generator must not render more than this.

description.description: Semantic intent of the action, e.g. 'apply the branch facet'. NOT an implementation instruction.

precondition.description: Boolean constraint over signature_vars; empty means always available.

fact_acquisition.description: How each answer-critical fact from S0 is earned. This is the contract the ground-truth script must satisfy and the coverage checker validates.

modality.description: Free-form. Inspiration, not a menu -- mixing several within one environment is encouraged. Examples: rendered-text, table-cell, file-export-download, chart-tooltip-hover, per-datapoint-scattered, form-gated-result, modal-only, accordion-collapsed, canvas-rendered, cross-app-join, sort-or-paginate-to-reach.

state.description: State in which the fact becomes legible.

path.description: Action ids from the initial state.

repeat_per_record.description: True when the path must be walked once per record (scattered collection) rather than yielding all records at once.

min_actions.description: Lower bound guarantees the environment poses real GUI work.

max_actions.description: Upper bound prevents degenerating into a test of patience.

noise_plan.description: UI chrome only -- never participates in fact acquisition, so it cannot threaten correctness.

distractor_records.description: Which non-critical corpus records to surface as noise.
